name: bughunt-suite
description: Offensive hotspot-driven hunt workflow for bugs, pain points, and inefficiencies — 13 analysis lenses, a zero-dependency toolkit (deterministic hotspots, structured findings, fingerprinted dedupe, baseline diffing, SARIF/HTML/markdown reports, CI exit codes), enforceable verification and coverage in CI, a fast Cursor-CLI fan-out variant (Composer 2.5 / Grok hunters, strong-model verify) and an optional E2B-backed Confirm rung, plus companion triage and fuzz skills. Report-only.
